vt_operational_readiness_meta.interpretation: bounded operational readiness score in [0,1], not a literal realized service-success probability
vt_operational_readiness_meta.construction: bottleneck-aware weighted harmonic-style aggregation of VT energy adequacy and VT operational adequacy, with floor clipping
vt_operational_readiness_meta.ops_blend_component: 0.5 * (departure_capacity_component + aircraft_component), then integrated with energy via weighted harmonic-style formula
